passage.text: Emma, help! My laptop won't turn on!
passage.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈhɛlp! maɪ ˈlæptɑːp ˈwoʊnt ˈtɜːrn ˈɑːn!

passage.text: I spilled coffee on the keyboard this morning.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈspɪld ˈkɔːfi ɑːn ðə ˈkiːbɔːrd ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: I cleaned it, but now the screen is black.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈkliːnd ɪt, bʌt ˈnaʊ ðə ˈskriːn ɪz ˈblæk.

passage.text: My history assignment is on it, and I didn't back it up!
passage.reading: maɪ ˈhɪstəri əˈsaɪnmənt ɪz ɑːn ɪt, ənd aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈbæk ɪt ˈʌp!

passage.text: I have to hand it in tomorrow.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈhæf tə ˈhænd ɪt ˈɪn təˈmɑːroʊ.

passage.text: OK, I'm at the service center now.
passage.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, aɪm ət ðə ˈsɜːrvɪs ˌsɛntər ˈnaʊ.

passage.text: The technician says the keyboard is broken, but my files are safe.
passage.reading: ðə tɛkˈnɪʃən ˈsɛz ðə ˈkiːbɔːrd ɪz ˈbroʊkən, bʌt maɪ ˈfaɪlz ər ˈseɪf.

passage.text: He's going to fix it in two days.
passage.reading: hiːz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈfɪks ɪt ɪn ˈtuː ˈdeɪz.

passage.text: From now on, I'll back up my work every day.
passage.reading: frəm ˈnaʊ ˈɑːn, aɪl ˈbæk ˈʌp maɪ ˈwɜːrk ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: And no more coffee near my laptop!
passage.reading: ənd ˈnoʊ ˈmɔːr ˈkɔːfi ˈnɪr maɪ ˈlæptɑːp!
